title: Photo slideshow
summary: A film from the user's photos and a few clips, cut to music: a memory or holiday slideshow, an anniversary or team montage, a portfolio reel, a carousel as video, a real-estate photo tour.

notFor.when: the material is video footage of an event the user held or attended
the film is cut from licensed stock or supplied b-roll, not the user's photos
an ad that sells a product or app around one proposition, product photos included
an animated film of type, shapes or a mark, with photos at most as texture
the user's own recording of their speech, to cut or caption

alternatives.when: a scrapbook or paper look, or a portfolio laid out as a board of photos

qa: Every photo move starts and ends on a subject; no face is cropped through in any format
No photo stretch measures as frozen beyond the manual --longest-still target
Mixed orientations resolved per photo: crop and move, or blur-fill; no black bars in a vertical feed
One grade across photos from different cameras and years; dates and names are the user's

intake.ask: What is it for and who watches it: a family memory, a tribute, a portfolio, a listing, a carousel for a feed?
intake.why: Sets the order (chronology, story, walkthrough), the pace (calm or punchy edit:plan) and the variant

intake.ask: Where are the photos and clips, roughly how many, and are any HEIC from an iPhone?
intake.why: Selection works from 1.5-3x the photos the length holds; HEIC must be converted before asset:import

intake.ask: In what order should they run, and which photos must be in it?
intake.why: Only the user knows the story and the must-keep faces; capture dates set chronology only when confirmed
intake.default: chronological by capture date, the user approves the selection

intake.ask: Which music: a track you own or licensed, or one we find for you?
intake.why: A Short over 1 minute with any copyright claim is blocked on YouTube; Zillow Showcase refuses unlicensed music
intake.default: the sound-director's shortlist of licensed tracks

intake.ask: Should names, dates or places appear on screen, and in which language?
intake.why: Captions here are the user's facts, never guessed from files
intake.default: no on-screen text except a title card

intake.ask: Is everyone in the photos happy to be in a published video?
intake.why: Private photos of other people, children above all, need their consent before a public upload
intake.default: private sharing only until the user confirms

profiles.note: Reels up to 3 minutes are eligible for non-followers (Instagram for Creators); no speech, so only date and name captions; minimum is a house rule
Shorts run up to 3 minutes; over 1 minute any copyright claim blocks it worldwide, so use cleared music or stay at 60 s (YouTube Help)
A family or tribute film to share by link; length band is a house rule; playback turns loud audio down to about -14 LUFS (measured, see footage-edit)
Listing pages: Zillow Showcase takes 120 s or less, horizontal or vertical, listing only, branding only in the introduction (Aryeo help)

starter.note: photo-move carries every photo, with crops and fill from photo:focus; film-finish wraps the film; scene-bento-collage opens or closes a portfolio; slice-panels joins sections. warm-editorial suits memories

variants.title: Real-estate photo tour
variants.changes: Order is a walk from the street through the rooms to the best view; 3-4 s per room (inside the default --median-shot 2.5:5) with push-ins and pans along the room's lines; landscape and vertical; 120 s or less for Zillow; no people, no branding past the introduction, licensed music only

variants.title: Portfolio, lookbook or carousel reel
variants.changes: Punchy edit:plan, 1-2 s per photo on beats, so film:targets --median-shot 1:2.5 --cuts-per-minute 24:60 (house rule); hard cuts or slice-panels; the work fills the frame, never cropped through; scene-bento-collage opens or closes; one small caption per piece; vertical first
